user.title: Leapmotor Cloud
user.description: Connects Home Assistant to the Leapmotor cloud (unofficial). Leapmotor vehicles offer no local interface, all data and commands go through the manufacturer's cloud.

menu_options.demo: Try a simulated vehicle (no account needed)

certificate.title: App certificate
certificate.description: The Leapmotor cloud only accepts connections that present the client certificate of the official app. It is not part of this integration. Upload the certificate and its private key (PEM), or paste them. Alternatively put `app_cert.pem` and `app_key.pem` into the folder `{folder}`, then this step is skipped.

credentials.title: Leapmotor account

data_description.base_url: Only change this if your region uses a different server.

pin.title: Vehicle PIN
pin.description: Enter the PIN you use in the app for remote commands of **{vehicle}** (…{vin}). Home Assistant then uses it automatically whenever a command needs it. Without a PIN the vehicle stays read-only.

data_description.pin: The PIN is checked once with the cloud and stored in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description:
The Leapmotor cloud rejected the password of {username}. Please enter the current password.

{error}

reconfigure.title: Change credentials
reconfigure.description:
Replace the password and/or the app certificate of {username}. Empty fields keep their value.

{error}

error.invalid_certificate: The certificate or the key is invalid, or they do not belong together.
error.certificate_required: Please provide the certificate and its private key.
error.invalid_auth: Email address or password is wrong.
error.certificate_rejected: The server rejected the app certificate.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: The Leapmotor cloud cannot be reached.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicle is linked to this account.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.pin_attempts: The PIN was rejected several times. Setup stopped so that remote control does not get locked.
abort.demo_not_configurable: The simulated vehicle has no credentials.

polling.title: Polling intervals
polling.description: The cloud is only asked as often as needed. While a vehicle charges, drives, runs the air conditioning or was just used, the short interval applies, otherwise the long one. Asking too often can get the account locked.

data_description.interval_active: Charging, driving, air conditioning, or up to ten minutes after the vehicle was used.
data_description.charger_power_entity: When the wallbox starts or stops delivering power, the vehicle is asked shortly afterwards. This gives fast updates without constant polling.
data_description.daily_request_limit: Above this number the integration only asks once an hour until midnight.

pins.title: Vehicle PIN
pins.description: PIN of **{vehicle}** (…{vin}). Stored: {status}. Leave the field empty to keep the stored PIN.

security.title: Server certificate
security.description: The Leapmotor server uses a certificate of a private certificate authority. The integration remembers the certificate during setup and afterwards only accepts that one (certificate pinning).

error.idle_below_active: The idle interval must be at least as long as the active interval.

abort.pin_attempts: The PIN was rejected several times. Stopped so that remote control does not get locked.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Fix the connection first.

options.auto: Pinned certificate, accept regular renewals automatically (recommended)
options.strict: Pinned certificate only, confirm every change

pin_missing.message: No PIN is stored for this vehicle. Add it under Settings → Devices & services → Leapmotor Cloud → Configure → Vehicle PINs.

pin_rejected.message: The stored vehicle PIN was rejected. To protect the vehicle from being locked it is not sent again. Correct it in the options of the integration.

command_not_permitted.message: This account may not use the command: {error}

auth_failed.message: Signing in to Leapmotor failed. Please sign in again in the integration.

rate_limited.message: The Leapmotor cloud is slowing down requests: {error}

cannot_connect.message: The Leapmotor cloud cannot be reached: {error}

command_unconfirmed.message: The command was sent, but the vehicle did not confirm it in time. It may be in deep sleep or without mobile reception.

charge_plan_unsupported.message: On this model the charging schedule can only be changed in the vehicle or the app.

charge_plan_incomplete.message: The current charging schedule is incomplete. Please give start and end time as well, so that nothing has to be guessed.

not_plugged_in.message: The charging cable is not connected.

device_required.message: There are several Leapmotor vehicles. Please select one.

no_vehicles.message: No vehicle is linked to this account.

server_certificate_changed.title: Leapmotor server presents a new certificate ({account})

confirm.title: Trust the new certificate?

abort.not_available: The certificate is no longer available. It will be shown again on the next connection attempt.

pin_rejected.title: Vehicle PIN rejected ({vehicle})
pin_rejected.description: The Leapmotor cloud rejected the stored PIN of {vehicle}. To protect remote control from being locked, Home Assistant does not send it again. Enter the correct PIN under Settings → Devices & services → Leapmotor Cloud → Configure → Vehicle PINs.

app_certificate_rejected.title: Leapmotor app certificate rejected ({account})
app_certificate_rejected.description: The Leapmotor cloud no longer accepts the app certificate. Leapmotor may have replaced it with a new app version. Provide the current certificate under Settings → Devices & services → Leapmotor Cloud → ⋮ → Reconfigure.

session_conflict.title: Leapmotor account is used elsewhere at the same time ({account})
session_conflict.description: The cloud session ended several times within a short time, most likely because the same account is also signed in on a phone. To protect the account, Home Assistant pauses for two hours. Create a second Leapmotor account, share the vehicle with it in the app, and use that account in Home Assistant.
